items.description: Laptop screen crack repair (complete display assembly)
items.rationale: Covered under 2.6.2/2.6.3(a): thrown against car door by a swerve. Purchase price about EUR 1,400; both repairs together stay below replacement, so 7.1.10 cap is not triggered. Display is the major share, about EUR 850.
Enclosure damage from the same event is covered under 2.6.3(b) as one loss on one unit. Lower housing shell swap including labour estimated at about EUR 380, combined total below replacement value.
Pre-existing surface condition; 7.1.11 and 7.1.8(a) state that treating it is not a repair cost, so excluded.
Examination cost admitted under 5.2.3 as an insured event exists; capped at EUR 250 gross. Typical diagnostic fee about EUR 70.
